questions.question: Evaluate: 3(x² + 2x - 5) - 2(x² - 3x + 1) when x = -2
questions.explanation: First simplify: 3(x² + 2x - 5) - 2(x² - 3x + 1) = 3x² + 6x - 15 - 2x² + 6x - 2 = x² + 12x - 17. When x = -2: (-2)² + 12(-2) - 17 = 4 - 24 - 17 = -37. That doesn't match A. Let me recalculate: 3x² + 6x - 15 - 2x² + 6x - 2 = (3-2)x² + (6+6)x + (-15-2) = x² + 12x - 17. At x = -2: 4 - 24 - 17 = -37. Still -37. Let me adjust answer.
